method: round 5: WHO ATC/DDD Index (atcddd.fhi.no) mapping from the brand-confirmed ingredient identities in hidden_files/payamdaroosaz_brand_lookups_29.md (28/29 found on پیام داروساز; 52360 not found). Accepted only with exact WHO evidence: an exact ingredient entry, a route/form entry, an exact combination entry, a WHO combination bucket naming the (main) ingredient, or a WHO guideline text deciding the code. 6 resolved, 23 left blank. R05X was NOT used for the 7 cold preparations: the WHO R05 guideline routes therapeutic-analgesic cold preparations to N02/M01 and only minimal-analgesic ones to R05X, and the analgesic's identity is unconfirmed for those codes. «پیام داروساز» NOT used for ATC (it shows none anywhere).
